info.name: ZAI 26Z - Serie pomiarowe API
info.description:
Full test suite for the ZAI 26Z API contract (zai-api-26z.yaml).

Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or `newman run`). It creates its own series and sensor, and deletes them at the end, leaving the F11 sample data untouched.

Set `baseUrl`, `adminUsername` and `adminPassword` in the collection variables (or override with `newman --env-var`).
